hook.head: Field File 19 · Farm Country Before the War
rows: Farm country, like north Florida before the Civil War
Your teacher, still stuck inside Canvas
hook.alt: An old map of the whole state of Florida
hook.cap: The new State of Florida, drawn by U.S. Army mapmakers in 1846. Library of Congress.
hook.note: In 1845 Florida became a state. Its money came from big farms. Can you go look at farm country?

opti.brief: She can't leave Canvas, so you go. Scout farm country in VR and send her one short video.
opti.desk: No headset? Use my desk. Play the game, then write 2 sentences for your teacher.

vr.look: Antebellum means before the war. Florida's money came from big farms called plantations. This map is not Florida, but it has fields.

place.alt: A small cabin with gray walls, a chimney and a shingle roof
place.html: Who did the work: enslaved people, forced to work with no pay.
place.cap: Slave quarters at Kingsley Plantation, near Jacksonville, built about 1822 to 1830. Library of Congress.

say: Before the war, Florida's big farms grew ___, and the work was done by ___.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
@PLACE@

In your video, you say these 2 sentences:

@SAY@

Practice now. Say both before the timer ends.

@TIMER@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Countryside in Filter environments. Click The Countryside, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Scout the farm
steps.html: Move with the thumbstick. Look at the fields and the farm buildings. Stop where you can see a big field.

steps.title: Record your video and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Fit the field in the tablet. Click Record video, say your 2 sentences, and click it again to stop.

On the Canvas tab, pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your video, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 To fix it, send a new video.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your video is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? See Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Turn slowly while you record, so your teacher sees how big the fields are.

vr.full: One video, 30 seconds or less, showing the place while you say both sentences.

studio.title: Odd One Out: Before the War
studio.look: Each round has 4 cards. Three go together. One does not belong.
studio.do: Read the question. Tap the card that does NOT belong.

game.miss: That one belongs. Read the question again.
game.done: Four rounds done! Statehood came in 1845, but freedom did not come for everyone.
